description: Which part of the day a meal belongs to, from its local time in minutes since midnight. Half-open bands: breakfast [240, 630), lunch [630, 900), dinner [1050, 1350), snack for everything else.

cases.why: 04:00 opens breakfast: the band start is inclusive, so a very early meal is not a snack.
03:59 is still the night: anything before the breakfast band is a snack, never yesterday's dinner.
A typical 08:15 breakfast lands in the breakfast band, the common case every port must get right.
10:30 is the first lunch minute: the boundary belongs to lunch, not to breakfast (half-open bands).
15:00 is no longer lunch: the band end is exclusive, so the afternoon starts as snack time.
The 15:00-17:30 gap between lunch and dinner is snack time on purpose (goûter).
17:30 opens dinner, inclusive, so an early family dinner is not filed as a snack.
22:30 is past dinner: a late plate after the band is a snack, matching how people describe it.
Seconds are dropped by flooring, so 10:29:59 (629.98 minutes) is still breakfast, not rounded up to lunch.
